name: The Daydreamer
summary: One of the six Wayward Haints of the Ghostlight Express.

stages.journal: A boy in overalls in the Dining Car, eating to bury something. He stole a painted toad-stone and lost it somewhere on the train.
stages.hint: A booth in the Dining Car. Talk to them, or ask the Vagrant through a grille.

stages.journal: We brought him the toad-faced stone from the marionette chest. He went to tell the truth.
We talked him round. He went to tell the truth.
We corked him in a jar; the plates are empty.

stages.hint: Fight it, or leave the car; it will not follow.

stages.journal: We put him down, gently as we could. The car is quiet.
